name: Fiber Festival of New England
description: The Fiber Festival of New England returns to the Eastern States Exposition's Mallary Complex in West Springfield, MA, presented by Eastern States Exposition in partnership with the New England Sheep & Wool Growers Association. The two-day festival features fiber-arts vendors, fleece and yarn sales, sheep and alpaca, spinning, knitting and crochet demonstrations, and competitions. A strong booth opportunity for fiber producers, dyers, and handcraft vendors.

name: Fiber Festival of New England
description: The Fiber Festival of New England returns to the Mallary Complex at the Eastern States Exposition in West Springfield, MA. The festival features more than 200 booths and 22 workshops for fiber enthusiasts, with sheep shearing, a fleece sale, fiber animals, spinning and weaving demonstrations, finished items for sale, and a fiber fashion show. Admission is $9 for ages 13 and up; children under 12 are free, and tickets are also sold at the door.
